entities.name: Matatios
entities.description: A human who met himself as a physical reflection after falling in love with his reflection in a lake.

entities.name: Perisophia
entities.description: A teacher who used Matatios's story to teach her students the power of one's mind and intention.

events.summary: Matatios's infatuation with himself causes his reflection to manifest wholly, and he meets himself.
events.quote: caused his reflection to manifest wholly

relations.note: Perisophia used his story to teach her students.
